summary: scripts/st-test --check rust-tests signs the crates of a run side by side (ST_TEST_SIGN_JOBS, default 8), evaluates the dev shell digest once, and pushes all the records in one push, instead of a serial signature and push per crate

replay.detail: CI and local tooling only; no product code changes.

compatibility.detail: No product contract change. Each record's content and signature are as before; only when they are made and pushed changes.
